author: Crazy_
body:
Hi. So I have never ever played an Avicus scrim before. While I typically enjoy reffing more than scrimming, I want to try it out. I'm looking for a team that will let me play a few scrims with them, but not be upset if I don't stay to play competitively/stick around (since I want to be reffing for the next couple tournaments). I don't care if the team is good or bad, so long as it's at least semi-active.

It's been a long time since I made my last LFT thread on OCN, so I'm not sure what comes next. I think it's the experience and skills part. 
So I've played in 3 OCN events to date. I've also scrimed with various other teams, but never for an event with them.

 - Breaking Core - Building Blox
 - Boom in a Box - ClutchCrewV2
 - Star War Wars - Kappa

I'm half decent in melee, and better with a bow. I can't fast bridge at all. I'll play whatever, (though I'm not sure whatever is, since I presume Avi and OCN work a little differently in scrims).

I have TS, and Mumble (if for whatever reason an Avi team uses it). My skype is dylan.thomson521
